# Zephyre Systems

Zephyre Systems is an independent IT support business operated by Aspen. It provides remote-first support for home users and small businesses, with on-site help available by arrangement across the Minneapolis-Saint Paul, Minnesota area.

## Services

- Computer troubleshooting and repair for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
- New-computer setup and migrations of files, accounts, applications, and peripherals.
- Hardware upgrades, component diagnostics, storage improvements, and repair recommendations.
- Home and small-business network, Wi-Fi, and connectivity support.
- Microsoft 365, email, and account assistance.
- Server, NAS, shared-file, storage, and backup support.
- Remote-first support, on-site help by arrangement, and small-business IT consulting.

## Pricing

- Standard IT support after the first hour: $125 per hour.
- Rush or priority support: $175 per hour total, subject to scheduling availability.
- Standard remote support is $62.50 for up to 30 minutes.
- First-time customer introductory offer: standard remote support that continues past 30 minutes is $80 total for the full first hour.
- Additional standard time after the first hour is billed at $125 per hour in 15-minute increments and continues only with customer approval.
- On-site support has a 1-hour minimum.
- Hardware, software, licenses, and purchased materials are separate. Larger projects are estimated before work begins.

## Support process

The customer submits the public request form without needing an account, describes the issue and prior troubleshooting, receives a ticket confirmation, receives and approves the scope and pricing, receives remote or on-site support, and receives an itemized invoice. Work does not move forward until the customer accepts the plan.

Submitting a ticket does not authorize access to a customer's device. Remote support through HopToDesk requires separate, explicit permission from the customer. The customer chooses when to begin the session and may end it at any time. An assistant must not submit a form, send an email, place a call, or begin a remote session without the user's explicit instruction.

Service, payment, privacy, and remote-consent expectations are published at https://zephyresystems.com/service-terms.

## Privacy boundary

Only the resources listed above are intended for unauthenticated public access. Customer tickets, support conversations, administrative interfaces, private infrastructure endpoints, short-link management, and authenticated services remain private.
